_readme: How Helixora chooses which companies to cover. scripts/universe.mjs re-runs the screen monthly. Coverage policy (approved 2026-11-11, replacing the 2026-11-06 policy of 100 companies with a $100M to $5B market value and a Phase II or III trial): every company that meets the rules is covered, up to 250; a company stays while it still qualifies; if more than 250 qualify, places go in order of soonest trial completion. A company that is bought is removed from the site once the deal closes, whoever the buyer. Every change is logged in 'changes'.
rules: Listed on Nasdaq, NYSE or NYSE American (no OTC)
Burned more than $20M of operating cash in the latest fiscal year
Clinical stage: revenue under $50M, or under a quarter of cash burned
SEC industry code for drug developers (2834, 2836, 8731)
Trades at least $1M a day (3-month average)
At least one active, company-sponsored clinical trial (Phase I, II or III)
Not acquired or being acquired: no tender offer or merger vote under way
selection: Up to 100 companies in all: the original companies plus the qualifying companies whose next Phase II or III trial finishes soonest.
funnel: Listed on Nasdaq, NYSE or NYSE American
Burned over $20M in operating cash in 2025
Has an active company-sponsored clinical trial (Phase I, II or III)

grandfathered.IDYA: Did not pass the cash-burn or revenue rule (partner payments)
